simple.meaning: דּוּר (dûwr) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to reside.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 13 times in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 2:38. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דּוּר (H1753) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: דּוּר (dûwr) / H1753 is traced through Daniel 2:38, Daniel 3:31, Daniel 4:9, Daniel 4:18 with source-language evidence and verse context.
